name: Pinchgut Opera under 35s and concession tickets
summary: Pinchgut Opera in Sydney offers concession prices to people under 35 and to Health Care Card holders.
who: People under 35 with proof of age.
how: Email proof of eligibility to ticketing@pinchgutopera.com.au.
catches: The page does not list prices or a student rush scheme.

evidence.quote: Valid proof of age ID if you are under 35 years old.
Proof of eligibility for Pensioner Concessions and Under 35s will need to be provided to Pinchgut Opera Ticketing on request, before tickets are issued.
